configure_rtmdet_x_p6_model: configure RTMDet-X P6 model with P6 backbone, multi-scale neck channels, and MlvlPointGenerator anchor strides
build_train_pipeline: build a training data pipeline with CachedMosaic, RandomResize, RandomCrop, YOLOXHSVRandomAug, CachedMixUp for 1280x1280 images
build_test_pipeline: build a test data pipeline with Resize, Pad, LoadAnnotations, and PackDetInputs for 1280x1280 inference
configure_training_schedule: configure 300-epoch training with LinearLR warmup, CosineAnnealingLR decay, EMAHook, and PipelineSwitchHook for stage 2
build_tta_pipeline: build a test-time augmentation pipeline with multi-scale resizing, random flips, and padding for RTMDet inference
